verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no built-in, in-product AI assistant that a user can delegate tasks to. LaunchDarkly's natural-language management runs through its MCP server, which requires an external AI client such as Cursor, Claude Code, or Windsurf. That is an adjacent integration, not an assistant inside the product, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: you must have an AI client that supports MCP, such as Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code with Copilot, or Windsurf.
Configure the hosted MCP server so you can manage feature flags and AgentControl configs, and view observability data, directly from your AI client.
